svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 1095 commits across five public projects, 77 active days, peak 114 commits per day. 2026-07-24 through 2026-10-15 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-10-15T15:19:35.618Z.
